notes.title: Snake Pass: Arcade Mode is now LIVE! (Update 1.4)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

We’re back with another update and some really cool new stuff to talk about. 
Would you believe that today marks a whole year since we launched Snake Pass into the world? 

It’s been a wild ride, and to celebrate the game’s first birthday, we’ve got a surprise for you.

Well… we say surprise, but by the time some of you read this, it will have already hit your consoles, so you’ll just have to just act surprised, instead…
Is that a drum roll in the distance? What bucket of thrills does that distant fanfare herald? 

Could it be…? 
Is it…? 

I think I can see something, bowling towards you right now, tumbling through its own dust clouds, eager to land on your console or PC…  A lesser-spotted CONTENT UPDATE! 

Welcome to ARCADE MODE.

You may recall that late last year we started teasing something a little bit fruity heading to Snake Pass. 

Well, it gives us great pleasure to introduce you to the brand-new mode included with update 1.4: ARCADE MODE.
 

It’s no secret that Snake Pass has a ton of retro platforming influences; after all it’s practically embedded in both Noodle and Doodle’s DNA! 
What better way to bridge the generational divide once more than by introducing an all-new retro classic with a modern, slithery twist.

ARCADE MODE is a take on the classic Score Attack mode: snake around each of Snake Pass' 15 levels, eating as much fruit as you can find to earn as high a score as possible. 

It’s simple, but ridiculously addictive. 

The aim of the game is to rack up massive multipliers and race to the gate before the time runs out as you compete with friends with full online leaderboard support. 

Jump in and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Snake Pass' latest update adds a free new Arcade Mode
notes.notes:
Sumo Digital just updated its serpentine physics platformer Snake Pass, adding a free new Arcade Mode, and remedying the game's controversial home screen icon on Switch.

Arcade Mode is out now on PC, Xbox One, PS4, and Switch, and can be played on all 15 of Snake Pass' existing levels once they're unlocked in the main story campaign. It's the second bonus mode to be included in Snake Pass, following on from Time Trial Mode, and tasks players with racing around a stage and gathering up fruit.

The more fruit you eat before the timer runs out, the higher your score multiplayer will climb and, thus, the higher your score on reaching the end-gate. Scores are uploaded to Snake Pass' online leaderboard, should you fancy attempting to best your friends and total strangers.

Read more…

notes.title: UPDATE: Leaderboard Resets INCOMING
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're just wanting to provide you all with a notice about our decision to instigate a global leaderboard reset in the next week.

Not long after Snake Pass was released, tonnes of you were jumping into Time Trials across PC, Xbox One and PlayStation 4 to see who could claim the highly-coveted title of the world’s top snake charmer! Whilst we were thrilled (but secretly seething…) to see so many of you put our own scores to shame, it became quickly apparent that a small number of players had discovered several exploits in the game that gave them an unfair advantage in the great leaderboard race of 2017. 

With the release of update 1.2 several fixes have been included on all platforms that remove these exploits from the game, making leaderboard progress much more friendly. No more turbo charged Noodles for you! This also means that some of the times are no longer even vaguely beatable from this point onwards…

With that in mind, we have decided that it is in the best interests of keeping things competitive and with Nintendo Switch players joining the fray, ONE WEEK after update 1.2’s release, we will be resetting all the current leaderboards. That means that the title of ultimate snaker will be back up for grabs and the race will well and truly be on. We look forward to seeing what times you guys will be recording this time round and maybe…just maybe…we’ll stand a chance of beating them this time round! 

We truly appreciate your support and understanding!

JuhTai
- Snake Pass Team

notes.title: Update 1.2 - LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Update 1.2 hit Steam recently and we thought we'd drop you all of the details;

[list]
[*]RAZER CHROMA: support for Razer Chroma Keyboards has been added

[*]4K UI: fixed a bug where the UI was not displaying correctly on 4k monitors 

[*]LANGUAGE: Steam version now sets to the language that Steam is set to rather than the OS of the PC

[*]TAIL GRAB: fixed a bug where Tail Grab was unreliable

[*]TIME TRIAL: fixed a TT exploit where players could get a time of zero

[*]TIME TRIAL: fixed an issue in Time Trial where some players could not complete the level
[*]TIME TRIAL: fixed an issue in Time Trial that prevented the timer from not displaying correctly

[*]LEVEL 11: fixed an issue where the ball would activate incorrectly for some players

[*]QUETZALCOATL ACHIEVEMENT: fixed an issue with Quetzalcoatl not triggering correctly for some players. If players have previously reached the requirements, playing a level without dying again should trigger the achievement.

[*]FLOOR IS MOLTEN ROCK ACHIEVEMENT: The Floor Is Molten Rock achievement now triggers correctly

[*]CAMERA: fixed an issue where the camera did not move as fast as intended

[*]LEVEL 9: fixed an issue where the camera would not move for some players making the level unplayable

[*]TAIL GRAB: fixed an issue where Noodle would move faster than intended while Doodle was holding his tail

[*]GAME ICONS: all platforms have updated game icons

[*]GENERAL FIXES AND PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS
[/list]
